primaryQuery: certified self-contained vehicle nz / green warrant
accuracyFlags: Section 01 says blue warrants 'remain valid until they expire, and no later than 31 December 2027': blue warrants have not been recognised since 7 June 2026, so this is wrong as of 19 October 2026.
Section 01 says 'From 7 June 2025, new certifications required a toilet fixed into the vehicle': the fixed-toilet regime started 7 June 2023 (date looks wrong by two years).
Second paragraph is future tense ('Once that period closes, a blue warrant will no longer establish compliance') and advises recertifying 'before the deadline': the deadline has passed.
'Keep in mind' box repeats 'Blue warrants lapse by 31 December 2027' and the page is stamped 'Updated 18 August 2026' despite being stale.
Link label 'MBIE freedom camping transition' points to a transition page that no longer reflects the current rules; replace with current MBIE / NZ Self Containment register pages.
Does not mention that DOC conservation-land notices differ from council bylaws; add one line with the DOC link.
